title: State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring reasoning capabilities from frontier models to smaller models, while extending its success to multi-turn agentic environments remains challenging. We study agentic OPD through interaction states, distinguishing the objective task and executed action-observation record from the internal semantic trajectory of student reasoning. Through this lens, we identify two roles of student reasoning in multi-turn OPD: prior reasoning distorts teacher supervision, while current reasoning shapes the action alternatives sampled at the same state. Specifically, at matched interaction states, removing prior student reasoning improves teacher continuation success and changes the teacher's token-level targets, with larger continuation gains at later turns. Meanwhile, resampling complete reasoning-action responses yields greater action diversity at the same state than resamplin

translated_title: State-OPD：面向多轮智能体的状态锚定在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为将前沿模型的推理能力迁移到更小模型的一种强大范式，但将其成功扩展到多轮智能体环境仍具挑战性。我们通过交互状态来研究智能体OPD，将客观任务和已执行的动作-观察记录与学生推理的内部语义轨迹区分开来。透过这一视角，我们识别出学生推理在多轮OPD中的两个角色：先验推理会扭曲教师监督，而当前推理则塑造在同一状态下所采样的动作备选方案。具体而言，在匹配的交互状态下，移除先验的学生推理可以提高教师续写的成功率并改变教师的token级目标，且在越靠后的轮次中续写收益越大。同时，重采样完整的推理-动作响应比重采样……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出State-OPD，通过交互状态将学生推理区分为先验推理与当前推理两种角色——先验推理会扭曲教师监督、当前推理影响同状态下的动作多样性——从而实现更有效的多轮智能体在线策略蒸馏。
en_tdlr: State-OPD grounds on-policy distillation in interaction states, disentangling two roles of student reasoning—prior reasoning distorting teacher supervision and current reasoning shaping action diversity—to enable more effective multi-turn agentic distillation.
